question: Which of the following was introduced to separate electorates, to widen the gap between Hindus and Muslims?
solution:
Correct answer is__** **____**The Morely-Minto Reforms**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Minto-Morley Reforms of 1909 known for separate Muslim electorates.
 
• It was instituted to placate the Moderates (Congress) and **establish separate electorates on the basis of religions.**
 
• The Indian Councils Act, 1909** establish a few reforms in the legislative councils **and the act increased the involvement of Indians in the governance of British India. 
 
• So, Lord Minto came to be called as **the Father of Communal Electorate in India. **

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• The Rowlatt acts **allowed certain political cases to be tried without juries and permitted internment of suspects without trial**.**​ **
 
• Ilbert Bill, in the history of India, **a controversial measure proposed in 1883 that sought to allow senior Indian magistrates to preside over cases involving British subjects in India**.
